verdict.rationale: There is direct probe evidence that Relay's support site serves a working llms.txt file at https://support.relayfi.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with structured content describing the product, confirming an agent-oriented docs endpoint exists. Missing for 10: no evidence of broader agent-oriented documentation beyond this single file, no confirmation it covers full product surface, and no independent/community corroboration of agents actually using it.
